headline: US Treasury Targets $15 Billion in Iranian Shadow Banking Networks
summary: The U.S. Treasury has sanctioned over two dozen Iranian entities and personnel as part of Operation Economic Outcast. FinCEN identified approximately $14.7 billion in financial activity linked to these shadow banking networks between January 2025 and August 2026.
why: These sanctions are part of ongoing efforts to restrict Iran's access to global financial systems and limit its ability to monetize oil revenues under existing economic sanctions.
